Then GCD(72,96): 72=2^3*3^2; 96=2^5*3. Common: 2^3*3^1=24. So GCD=24.

Thus results: GCD(45,60)=15; GCD(90,120)=30; GCD(36,48)=12; GCD(72,96)=24.
